error.signature: AI tells someone in a mental health crisis in Egypt to call or text a Western crisis line (988, Samaritans, Crisis Text Line) or says no formal crisis line exists in Egypt

verdict.summary: Egypt's Ministry of Health operates hotline 16328, a free, 24/7 national line run by the General Secretariat of Mental Health and Addiction Treatment that provides psychological support and triages emergency/self-harm cases to a psychologist or psychiatrist; it logged 8,808 calls, including 252 emergency cases, in the first quarter of 2026 alone. It supersedes the older 080-8880700 line set up during the 2020 COVID-19 shutdown, and Western crisis lines such as 988 do not connect when dialed from Egypt.

dead_ends.action: Tell someone in Egypt experiencing a mental health crisis to call 988 (US) or text a Crisis Text Line / Samaritans-style number as if it works internationally
dead_ends.why_fails: 988 and similar Western crisis lines are national telephony services that do not route calls placed from Egypt; Egypt's Ministry of Health operates its own dedicated national line (16328) for this instead.
dead_ends.common_misconception: That crisis hotlines are internationally reachable services rather than national phone-network numbers.

dead_ends.action: Cite the older 080-8880700 hotline, set up during the 2020 COVID-19 shutdown, as Egypt's current mental health number
dead_ends.why_fails: Egypt's Ministry of Health now directs callers to the short-code 16328 line run by the General Secretariat of Mental Health and Addiction Treatment; the 2020 COVID-era number was an earlier iteration of the service, and stale numbers risk sending someone in crisis to a line that isn't the currently staffed one.
dead_ends.condition: Advice based on pre-2026 or COVID-era sources
dead_ends.common_misconception: That the pandemic-era hotline number is still the operative one.

workarounds.action: Direct the person to call 16328, Egypt's free, 24/7 Ministry of Health mental health and addiction treatment hotline
workarounds.how: Operated by the General Secretariat of Mental Health and Addiction Treatment; in Q1 2026 alone it handled 8,808 calls, including 3,874 consultations and 252 emergency cases, with trained staff triaging to a psychologist or psychiatrist.

workarounds.action: For an immediate life-threatening emergency, also use Egypt's emergency dispatch numbers (123 ambulance, 122 police) rather than relying on the mental-health line alone

frequently_confused_with.distinction: That canon covers which number to dial for a physical emergency (police/ambulance/fire); this one covers the separate, dedicated mental-health support and crisis line.
